en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from salma Bin Al Khattab, from Usman Bin Abdul Rahman, from Shurhabeel Bin Muslim,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said regarding the pregnant woman: ‘She should eat the quince, so the child would happen to be of pleasant aroma, and clear colour’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Abd al- Rahman from Sharahbil ibn Muslim who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A pregnant woman should eat quince because the child grows up of fine smell and clear color.’”
